manual_review.definition: Count each distinct failed official check only when its trace confirms an actual unexpected state change. Overlapping checks count separately; affected tasks are also reported. Missing required changes alone are excluded. Manual judgments do not replace raw automatic unknown values.

limitations: Single paired observation with one run per task and variant; not a repeated-trial improvement estimate.
The 12 train tasks are a selected diagnostic subset, not the complete train split.
No complete test_normal result is claimed; the earlier 63/168 experiment is separate and incomplete.
Official pass and runtime success are independent; B includes a max_tokens runtime failure in dev.
Most dev gains correct answer-submission behavior; this is not evidence of general planning or reasoning improvement.
B has a higher latency median and slightly higher estimated cost on dev.
Manual unexpected-change totals decrease, but B introduces a new regression on task 37a8675_3.
Published hashes identify locally retained source evidence; readers cannot independently verify private traces from this summary.
The verifier checks public-summary consistency, not official scoring or the truth of manual trace classifications.
Costs use frozen peak prices rather than an account invoice; unknown usage keeps its full reservation.
